# final samples to be included in analyses
```{r}
samples_drop=c('D17_2', 'P17_1', 'O5_1', 'O15_1', 'N17_1', 'M4_2', 'M20_2', 'M19_1', 'M16_2', 'K1_1', 'K21_2', 'K19_2', 'K17_2', 'K11_1', 'J7_2', 'J1_2', 'J17_1', 'I13_1', 'H5_2', 'H13_2', 'F5_2', 'F23_2', 'F21_2', 'F1_2', 'E7_1', 'E21_1', 'E18_2', 'E16_2', 'E12_2', 'E10_2', 'D5_2', 'D19_1', 'D11_2', 'C3_1', 'C1_1', 'B15_1', 'A23_1', 'A21_1', 'A13_2', 'A14_2', 'K23_2')

possible_contam <- readRDS(paste0(dataDir, "sample_data_from_original_capscan_study.RDS")) %>%
  filter(possible_contam == TRUE)

samples_used <- meta %>%
  filter(!samplename %in% samples_drop) %>%
  filter(!Type=="Saliva") %>%
  filter(!Subject %in% c("Control_1", "Control_2")) %>%
  filter(!Set %in% c(1,6,7,8,9,10,11,12,13)) %>%
  # remove 7 samples that were resequenced (subject 4,    subject 3)
  #keep sample with more mapped reads
  filter(!samplename %in% c("O17_1", "O19_1", "O21_1", "L23_1",     "K23_1", "M15_1", "M23_1")) %>%
  filter(!samplename %in% possible_contam$meta_samplename)

n_samples_total <- samples_used %>%
  # find the number of genes in each sample and the sum of their RPKGs
  group_by(Type) %>%
  summarize(n_samples=n_distinct(samplename))
sum((n_samples_total %>% filter(str_detect(Type, "Capsule")))$n_samples)

saveRDS(n_samples_total, file = paste0(dataDir, "/sensitivity/number_samples_type.rds"))

```


# Read in dsrAB gene counts
```{r}
# capsule data
capsule <- read_tsv(paste0(abundanceDir, "/Capsule/concat_dsrAB_Capsule_Abundances_RPKG_redo.txt"))
# stool data
stool <- read_tsv(paste0(abundanceDir, "/Stool/concat_dsrAB_Stool_Abundances_RPKG_redo.txt"))
# combine capsule and stool data
samples <- bind_rows(capsule, stool) %>%
  mutate(subject=as.numeric(str_extract(.$coassembly, "\\d+")))
```

```{r}
#which hits are dups?
# want to make sure they all get filtered out since they have NA for distance
closest_ref_no_2018 <- read_csv(paste0(dataDir, "closestRefInfo_allScoreThresholdHits_wSingleClosestRef_no_2018_capsule.csv")) 
dups <- closest_ref_no_2018 %>%
  filter(is.na(distance)) %>%
  # agree that all but two are duplicates (they have another hit to the same gene)
# Stool_14 220955_5 and Capsule_14 148417_5 should be added back in because they were marked as duplicates for genes in different coassemblies!
  filter(!str_detect(hit_id, "Stool_14.k141_220955_5/63-175|Capsule_14.k141_148417_5/63-175"))

samples_no_dups <- samples %>%
  filter(!geneLoc %in% dups$hit_id)
```

```{r}
# filter and remove duplicate genes
samples_unique_genes <- samples_no_dups %>%
  # Remove RPKGs of 0 (feature counts keeps genes even when nothing has mapped to them) 
  filter(RPKG>0) %>%
# make subject a factor
  mutate(subject = factor(subject)) %>%
# add capsule type (1,2,3,4, most proximal to most distal)
  left_join(meta %>% select(samplename, Type, Set), 
            by = c("sample" = "samplename")) %>%
  #remove practice capsules found in subject 1 and others
  filter(!Set %in% c(1,6,7,8,9,10,11,12,13)) %>%
  # remove 7 samples that were resequenced (subject 4,    subject 3)
  #keep sample with more mapped reads
  filter(!sample %in% c("O17_1", "O19_1", "O21_1", "L23_1",     "K23_1", "M15_1", "M23_1")) %>%
  # remove potentially contaminated capsules from analysis
  filter(!sample %in% possible_contam$meta_samplename) %>%
# filter for unique genes in each sample
# want to keep gene domain with the highest score, if there is a tie return just the first hit encountered
  group_by(geneID, sample) %>%
  slice_max(Score, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

samples_unique_genes_zeroes <- samples_no_dups %>%
  # keep RPKGs of zero
# make subject a factor
  mutate(subject = factor(subject)) %>%
# add capsule type (1,2,3,4, most proximal to most distal)
  left_join(meta %>% select(samplename, Type, Set), 
            by = c("sample" = "samplename")) %>%
  #remove practice capsules found in subject 1 and others
  filter(!Set %in% c(1,6,7,8,9,10,11,12,13)) %>%
  # remove 7 samples that were resequenced (subject 4,    subject 3)
  #keep sample with more mapped reads
  filter(!sample %in% c("O17_1", "O19_1", "O21_1", "L23_1",     "K23_1", "M15_1", "M23_1")) %>%
  # remove potentially contaminated capsules from analysis
  filter(!sample %in% possible_contam$meta_samplename) %>%
# filter for unique genes in each sample
# want to keep gene domain with the highest score, if there is a tie return just the first hit encountered
  group_by(geneID, sample) %>%
  slice_max(Score, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

samples_in_coassemblies_no_hits <- meta %>% 
  filter(samplename %in% setdiff(unique(samples_used$samplename), unique(samples_unique_genes_zeroes$sample)))
# these are the samples that are from coassemblies with no hits (which are not the same as samples from coassemblies with hits but no reads mapping in the individual sample)
```

# get tree
```{r}

rooted_ref_tree_2015 <- root(ref_tree_2015, c("Moorella_thermoacetica_Y72_copy_2__MooTher5"), r = TRUE)
```

# get names of closest references and filter to remove gene duplicates
```{r}
## 2015 only 
closest_ref_2015 <- read_csv(paste0(dataDir, "closestRefInfo_allScoreThresholdHits_wSingleClosestRef_no_2018_capsule.csv"))

# read in df that filters out gene duplicates in each sample (selects the domain with the highest bit score) 
# this df is made in dm_abundance.Rmd
samples_unique_genes_with_names_2015 <- readRDS(paste0(dataDir, "/sensitivity/samples_unique_genes_with_names_no_2018.rds"))

# manually select a subunit for the 6 contigs found in contigs_multiple_refs
partial_genes <- c("Capsule_14.k141_153065_1", "Stool_14.k141_240693_1", "Stool_9.k141_270672_1")
unknown_species <- c("Capsule_7.k141_250498_14", "Stool_7.k141_215370_50")
# and rename 113757 to D. piger based on blast results

samples_unique_subunit_manual <- samples_unique_genes_with_names_2015 %>%
  filter(!geneNum %in% partial_genes) %>%
  filter(!geneNum %in% unknown_species) %>%
  mutate(single_closest_ref = ifelse(contig == "k141_113757", "Desulfovibrio_piger__DslPige3", single_closest_ref))

# filter to get one subunit (8 are Moorella which is why there is 301 instead of 293 like in abundance_figures.rmd)
samples_unique_subunit_RPKG_2015 <- samples_unique_subunit_manual %>%
  group_by(contig, sample) %>%
  slice_max(RPKG, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

# filter the closest_ref df to only have the unique gene hits
# this df is much smaller since hits are not split up by sample
closest_ref_filtered_2015 <- closest_ref_2015 %>%
  filter(hit_id %in% samples_unique_subunit_RPKG_2015$geneLoc)
```

# find the number of subjects that have a hit for a species
```{r}
## 2015
subjects_per_species_2015 <- closest_ref_filtered_2015 %>%
  # filter out hits that are too far from the closest reference
  filter(distance < 2.5) %>%
  # add variable for the subject
  mutate(subject = str_split(biosample_id, "\\_", simplify = TRUE)[, 2]) %>%
  # count the number of subjects that have a hit for each species
  distinct(single_closest_ref, subject) %>%
  group_by(single_closest_ref) %>%
  summarize(n_subjects = n())

subjects_per_species_2015$logFreq <- log2(subjects_per_species_2015$n_subjects + 1)

```

```{r}
### Read in datasets from dm_abundance
samples_unique_gene_casette <- readRDS(paste0(dataDir, "/sensitivity/samples_unique_genes_with_names_no_2018.rds"))
samples_unique_gene_casette_zeroes <- readRDS(paste0(dataDir, "/sensitivity/samples_unique_genes_with_names_no_2018_zeroes.rds"))

#looking to see which contigs are mapping to several species
contigs_multiple_refs <- samples_unique_gene_casette %>%
  group_by(contig) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(single_closest_ref) > 1)%>%
  # filter out contigs where multiple species are both Bilophila species or both D. piger; we don't care about these
  # want to fix the contigs mapping to species that are farther apart on the tree
  filter(!all(grepl("Bil|piger", single_closest_ref))) %>%
  summarize(
    n_refs = n_distinct(single_closest_ref),
    refs = paste(unique(single_closest_ref), collapse = "; ")
  )

### choose a representative subunit

# manually select a subunit for the 6 contigs found in contigs_multiple_refs
partial_genes <- c("Capsule_14.k141_153065_1", "Stool_14.k141_240693_1", "Stool_9.k141_270672_1")
unknown_species <- c("Capsule_7.k141_250498_14", "Stool_7.k141_215370_50")

samples_unique_subunit_manual <- samples_unique_gene_casette %>%
  filter(!geneNum %in% partial_genes) %>%
  filter(!geneNum %in% unknown_species) %>%
  mutate(single_closest_ref = ifelse(contig == "k141_113757", "Desulfovibrio_piger__DslPige3", single_closest_ref))

samples_unique_subunit_manual_zeroes <- samples_unique_gene_casette_zeroes %>%
  filter(!geneNum %in% partial_genes) %>%
  filter(!geneNum %in% unknown_species) %>%
  mutate(single_closest_ref = ifelse(contig == "k141_113757", "Desulfovibrio_piger__DslPige3", single_closest_ref))

## value of 293 comes from this
samples_unique_subunit_RPKG <- samples_unique_subunit_manual %>%
  filter(single_closest_ref != "Moorella_thermoacetica_Y72_copy_2__MooTher5") %>%
  group_by(contig, sample) %>%
  slice_max(RPKG, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()
```

## get summary statistics for text
```{r}
# we want to know the number of unique hits in a coassembly (do not double-count contigs that show up in different samples)
# choose one subunit per **coassembly**; this is accomplished by grouping by subject and contig
unique_hits_summary <- samples_unique_gene_casette %>%
  filter(single_closest_ref != "Moorella_thermoacetica_Y72_copy_2__MooTher5") %>%
  group_by(subject, contig, sample_type) %>%
  slice_max(RPKG, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  # find the number of unique hits for each subject for stool and capsule
  group_by(subject, sample_type) %>%
  summarize(number_hits=n()) %>%
  # take the median number of unique contigs in subjects for each sample type
  group_by(sample_type) %>%
  summarize(n_hits_total=sum(number_hits), median_hits=median(number_hits), q_25=quantile(number_hits, probs=0.25), q_75=quantile(number_hits, probs=0.75))
```

## get summary statistics for Table 1
```{r}
capsule_type_summary <- samples_unique_subunit_RPKG %>%
  # find the number of genes in each sample and the sum of their RPKGs
  group_by(sample, subject, Type) %>%
  summarise(n_genes = n(), 
            total_RPKG = sum(RPKG)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  # find the median number of genes and median RPKG sum for all of the samples for a given subject and Type
  # need this center chunk because different subjects have different numbers of samples!
  group_by(subject, Type) %>%
  summarise(n_median = median(n_genes),
            median_total_RPKG = median(total_RPKG)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # find the median number of genes and median RPKG sum for each Type
  group_by(Type) %>% 
  summarise(n_subjects=n_distinct(subject),
            n_median_all_subj = round(median(n_median),2),
            n_25pct = round(quantile(n_median, probs = 0.25),2),
            n_75pct = round(quantile(n_median, probs = 0.75),2),
            median_RPKG_all_subj = round_tidy(median(median_total_RPKG),2),
            RPKG_25pct = round_tidy(quantile(median_total_RPKG, probs = 0.25),2),
            RPKG_75pct = round_tidy(quantile(median_total_RPKG, probs = 0.75),2)) %>% 
  mutate(n_genes_per_sample = paste0(n_median_all_subj, " [IQR ", n_25pct, "-", n_75pct, "]"),
         median_RPKG_sum_per_sample = paste0(median_RPKG_all_subj, " [IQR ", RPKG_25pct, "-", RPKG_75pct, "]")) %>%
  select(Type, n_subjects, n_genes_per_sample, median_RPKG_sum_per_sample)
```


```{r}
# from data management Rmd; all samples of each type
n_samples_all_by_type <- readRDS(paste0(dataDir, "sensitivity/number_samples_type.RDS")) %>%
  rename(n_samples_total=n_samples)

# positive samples of each type
n_samples_pos <- samples_unique_subunit_RPKG %>%
  group_by(Type) %>%
  summarize(n_samples_pos=n_distinct(sample))
# add up capsule numbers to get value for Table 1 caption
sum((n_samples_pos %>% filter(str_detect(Type, "Capsule")))$n_samples_pos)

# making a new summary to also include the number of samples for each type and percentages of samples/subjects that are positive
capsule_type_summary_new <- n_samples_pos %>% 
  left_join(n_samples_all_by_type, by = "Type") %>%
  left_join(capsule_type_summary, by = "Type") %>%
  mutate(pct_pos_samples = n_samples_pos/n_samples_total,
         pct_pos_subjects = n_subjects/15) %>%
  mutate(n_samples_pos = paste0(n_samples_pos, " (", percent(pct_pos_samples, accuracy = 0.01), ")"),
         n_subjects = paste0(n_subjects,    " (", percent(pct_pos_subjects, accuracy = 0.01), ")")) %>%
  select(-c(pct_pos_samples, pct_pos_subjects))
```

# Change closest ref labels
```{r}
species <- unique(samples_unique_subunit_RPKG$single_closest_ref)

species_labels <- c("Desulfitibacter_alkalitolerans__DfiAlka2" = "Desulfitibacter alkalitolerans",
                    "Desulfovibrio_piger__DslPige3" = "Desulfovibrio piger 3",
                    "Desulfovibrio_piger__DslPige4" = "Desulfovibrio piger 4",
                    "Bilophila_wadsworthia__BilWads6" = "Bilophila wadsworthia 6",
                    "uncultured_bacterium__EF645667" = "uncultured Desulfovibrio species",
                    "Bilophila_sp._4_1_30__BilSpec3" = "Bilophila species 3",
                    "Gordonibacter_pamelaeae__GrdPame5" = "Gordonibacter pamelaeae",
```

# plot RPKG for unique genes (each hit would be one subunit) in each sample to compare between location; facet by species
# this plot combines the two D. piger and two B. wadsworthia species
```{r}
samples_unique_subunit_RPKG %>%
  mutate(combine_species = case_when(
    single_closest_ref %in% c("Desulfovibrio_piger__DslPige3", "Desulfovibrio_piger__DslPige4") ~ "Desulfovibrio_piger",
    single_closest_ref %in% c("Bilophila_wadsworthia__BilWads6", "Bilophila_sp._4_1_30__BilSpec3") ~ "Bilophila_species",
    TRUE ~ single_closest_ref)) %>%
  mutate(combine_species = factor(combine_species, 
                                  levels = c("uncultured_bacterium__EF645667",
                                            "Desulfovibrio_piger",
                                            "Bilophila_species",
                                            "Desulfitibacter_alkalitolerans__DfiAlka2",
                                            "Gordonibacter_pamelaeae__GrdPame5"))) %>%
  mutate(combine_species = recode(combine_species, !!!species_labels_combine_species)) %>%
  # order subjects based on heatmap order
  mutate(subject = factor(subject, levels = c("12", "9", "14", "2", "13", "7", "3", "6", "4", "11", "1"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Type, y = log10(RPKG))) +
  geom_boxplot(color = "black",
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), size = 0.8, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Type),
            alpha = 1.6,
            position = position_jitterdodge(
        jitter.width = 0.5,
        dodge.width = 0.8)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = jitter_colors) +
  #get rid of box fill
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("transparent", "transparent", "transparent", "transparent", "transparent"), guide = "none") +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(size = 4)
    )) +
  facet_wrap(~ combine_species, 
             #scale = "free_y",
             labeller = labeller(combine_species = label_parsed)) +
  labs(
    title = expression(paste(italic("dsrAB"), " gene cluster abundance across species by type")),
    x = "Type",
    y = "log10(RPKG)",
    color = "Type"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, angle = 60, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5)
  )

ggsave(paste0(figureDir, "sensitivity/dsrAB_RPKG_combine_species.png"),
       width = 18, height = 14, units = "in",   # increase for larger output
       dpi = 600)
```

```{r}
RPKG_by_sample_type_MEDIAN <- samples_unique_subunit_RPKG %>%
  # combine d. piger and bilophila species
  mutate(combine_species = case_when(
    single_closest_ref %in% c("Desulfovibrio_piger__DslPige3", "Desulfovibrio_piger__DslPige4") ~ "Desulfovibrio_piger",
```

```{r}
# Create stool and capsule matrices
matrix_capsule <- matrix_sample_type_log[row_types_2 == "Capsule", ]
matrix_stool <- matrix_sample_type_log[row_types_2 == "Stool", ]

# Make sure columns are in the same order for both
common_cols <- intersect(colnames(matrix_capsule), colnames(matrix_stool))

subjects_capsule <- sapply(strsplit(rownames(matrix_capsule), "_"), function(x) x[1])
subjects_stool <- sapply(strsplit(rownames(matrix_stool), "_"), function(x) x[1])

# Use capsule subjects as the complete list (since it has 2 extra subjects)
all_subjects <- subjects_capsule

# Stool matrix already matches capsule dimensions, just needs to be expanded
n_cols <- ncol(matrix_capsule)

# Initialize stool matrix with zeros for all capsule subjects
matrix_stool_complete <- matrix(0, nrow = length(all_subjects), ncol = n_cols)
rownames(matrix_stool_complete) <- all_subjects
colnames(matrix_stool_complete) <- colnames(matrix_stool)

# Fill in the stool values that exist
for(i in 1:length(subjects_stool)) {
  subject <- subjects_stool[i]
  if(subject %in% all_subjects) {
    matrix_stool_complete[subject, ] <- matrix_stool[i, ]
  }
}

# Capsule matrix just needs subject names
rownames(matrix_capsule) <- subjects_capsule

# Now matrix_capsule and matrix_stool_complete have the same dimensions
# with 0 for subjects that don't appear in stool

# cluster the species and the subjects like the jitter box plot
species_order <- names(species_labels_combine_species_no_moorella)
subject_order <- c("9", "14", "2", "3", "12", "13", "7", "6", "4", "11", "1")

matrix_capsule <- matrix_capsule[subject_order, species_order]
matrix_stool_complete <- matrix_stool_complete[subject_order, species_order]

# Color functions for each group (using same scale for stool and capsule)
all_values <- c(as.vector(matrix_capsule), as.vector(matrix_stool_complete))
min_val <- min(all_values[all_values > 0], na.rm = TRUE)
# after removing the potentially contaminated samples, the medians increased
max_val <- max(all_values[all_values < 0.1], na.rm = TRUE)

col_fun <- colorRamp2::colorRamp2(seq(min_val, max_val, length.out = 10), 
                        viridis(10, begin = 0.9, end = 0.2))

# Create custom cell function to draw split cells
cell_func_hm <- function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
  # Get values from both groups
  val1 <- matrix_capsule[i, j]
  val2 <- matrix_stool_complete[i, j]
  
  # Draw left half (capsule)

  fill1 <- if (val1 == 0) {
      "white"
  } else if (val1 > 0.1) {
      "#440154"
    } 
    else {
     col_fun(val1)
   }
  grid.rect(x = x - width/4, y = y, 
            width = width/2, height = height,
            gp = gpar(col = NA, lwd = 0.5, fill = fill1))
  
  
  # Draw right half (stool)  
  fill2 <- if (val2 == 0) {
      "white"
  } else if (val2 > 0.1) {
      "#440154"
    } 
    else {
      col_fun(val2)
    }
  grid.rect(x = x + width/4, y = y,
            width = width/2, height = height,
            gp = gpar(col = NA, lwd = 0.5, fill = fill2))
 
  grid.rect(
    x = x, y = y,
    width = width, height = height,
    gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 0.4, fill = NA))
}

# Prepare column labels
col_labels_parsed_split <- parse(text = species_labels_combine_species_no_moorella[colnames(matrix_capsule)])
```

```{r}
png(paste0(figureDir, "sensitivity/heatmap_split_median.png"), width = 8, height = 6, units = "in", res = 600)

hm_split <- ComplexHeatmap::pheatmap(
  matrix_capsule,  # Use capsule as base since it has the right # of subjects (colors handled by cell_fun)
  cell_fun = cell_func_hm,
  #col = viridis(10, begin = 0.9, end = 0.2),  # For legend
  cluster_rows = FALSE,

  #column_title = expression(paste(italic("dsrAB"), " gene cluster abundance across species by sample type")),
  row_names_side = "left",

  row_title_side = "left",

)

legend_outlier <- Legend(labels = ">0.1000", title = expression(italic(dsrAB) ~ "abundance" ~ (log[10]*"(RPKG+1)")), 
                      legend_gp = gpar(fill = "#440154"),
                      grid_width = unit(0.4, "cm"))

legend_zeroes <- Legend(labels = "0.0000", title = "",
                   type = "points",
                   pch = 22,  # filled square
                   size = unit(5, "mm"),
                   legend_gp = gpar(fill = "white", col = "black"),
                   grid_width = unit(0.4, "cm"))

legend_main <- Legend(
  col_fun = col_fun,
  at = seq(min_val, max_val, length.out = 5),
  labels = sprintf("%.4f", seq(min_val, max_val, length.out = 5)),
  legend_height = unit(4, "cm"),

legend_all <- packLegend(legend_outlier, legend_main, legend_zeroes,
```

# get summary statistics for Figure 6A
```{r}
unique_hits_summary_dsr <- dsr_unique %>%
  filter(single_closest_ref != "Moorella_thermoacetica_Y72_copy_2__MooTher5") %>%
  # need to remove this partial gene because it was removed to make the other abundance figures and when it is removed, one sample is no longer in the df. This way, both the abundance figures and the asr/dsr figures will have 146 samples included in the analysis
  filter(!geneNum == "Stool_14.k141_240693_1") %>%
  # find unique contigs in each coassembly
  # don't care about how we are selecting a subunit here since we just want overall count. RPKG will be in figure part b
  group_by(subject, contig, sample_type) %>%
  slice_max(RPKG, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup %>%
  # find how many contigs are in each capsule type and stool
  group_by(subject, sample_type) %>%
  summarize(number_hits=n()) %>%
  group_by(sample_type) %>%
  # add up all the hits found in each subject for a given Type. take the median and find IQR
  summarize(n_hits_total=sum(number_hits), median_hits=median(number_hits), q_25=quantile(number_hits, probs=0.25), q_75=quantile(number_hits, probs=0.75)) %>%
  mutate(hits_per_subj = paste0(median_hits, " [IQR ", q_25, "-", q_75, "]")) %>%
  select(sample_type, n_hits_total, hits_per_subj)

unique_hits_summary_asr <- asr_unique %>%
  group_by(subject, contig, sample_type) %>%
  slice_max(RPKG, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup %>%
  group_by(subject, sample_type) %>%
  summarize(number_hits=n()) %>%
  group_by(sample_type) %>%
  summarize(n_hits_total=sum(number_hits), median_hits=median(number_hits), q_25=quantile(number_hits, probs=0.25), q_75=quantile(number_hits, probs=0.75)) %>%
  mutate(hits_per_subj = paste0(median_hits, " [IQR ", q_25, "-", q_75, "]")) %>%
  select(sample_type, n_hits_total, hits_per_subj)

## for these, the dsr hits get filtered by dups, etc. 
figure_6a <- unique_hits_summary_dsr %>% left_join(., unique_hits_summary_asr, by = "sample_type", suffix = c("_dsr", "_asr"))
```

# How do RPKGs compare to the dsrAB genes? 
# Cannot plot total RPKG since asrABC protein has 3 subunits while dsrAB has 2.
# Using median to account for this
```{r}
# Get median RPKG across contigs in each sample
# then find the sum of RPKG in a sample
plot_RPKG_dsr_median <- dsr_unique %>%
  filter(single_closest_ref != "Moorella_thermoacetica_Y72_copy_2__MooTher5") %>%
  # need to remove this partial gene because it was removed to make the other abundance figures and when it is removed, one sample is no longer in the df.
  filter(!geneNum == "Stool_14.k141_240693_1") %>%
  group_by(sample, contig, sample_type, subject, Type) %>%
  summarize(n=n(), median_RPKG=median(RPKG)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(sample, subject, sample_type, Type) %>%
  summarize(sum_RPKG=sum(median_RPKG)) 

plot_RPKG_asr_median <- asr_unique %>%
  group_by(sample, contig, sample_type, subject, Type) %>%
  summarize(n=n(), median_RPKG=median(RPKG)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(sample, subject, sample_type, Type) %>%
  summarize(sum_RPKG=sum(median_RPKG))
```


#box and jitter of both gene clusters
```{r}
# combine asr and dsr data
all_genes <- bind_rows(
  dsr = plot_RPKG_dsr_median,
  asr = plot_RPKG_asr_median,
  .id = "gene_cluster")

# plot a box for each cluster for each type, facet by subject
set.seed(125)
all_genes %>%
  #filter(subject==9) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sample_type, y = log10(sum_RPKG), fill = gene_cluster)) +
  geom_boxplot(color = "black",
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
               width = 0.6,
               outlier.shape = NA) +
  # Jitter points with viridis colors
  geom_jitter(aes(color = gene_cluster),
              alpha = 0.8, 
              size = 1.6,
              position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, jitter.height = 3, dodge.width = 0.8)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = gene_colors, labels = c(expression(italic(asrABC)), expression(italic(dsrAB)))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("transparent", "transparent"), guide = "none") +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~ subject, 
             #scales = "free_y",
             strip.position = "top",
             labeller = labeller(subject = function(x) paste("Subject", x))) +
  labs(
    title = expression(paste("Abundances of ", italic(asrABC), " and ", italic(dsrAB), " across sample types and subjects")),
    #subtitle = "Each point represents a sample",
    x = "Sample type",
    #median was taken across a contig to account for subunits
    y = expression("Gene abundance" ~ (log[10]*"RPKG")),
    color = "Gene cluster"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(size = 5)
    )) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, angle = 60, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5))
```

```{r}
all_genes_subset <- all_genes %>%

  filter(all(c("dsr", "asr") %in% gene_cluster)) %>%

plot_ratios <- all_genes_subset %>%

  mutate(ratio_dsr_asr = dsr/asr) 

summary_stats <- plot_ratios %>%
  group_by(sample_type) %>%
  summarise(median = round(median(ratio_dsr_asr),2),
            n_25pct = round(quantile(ratio_dsr_asr, probs = 0.25),2),

log_change <- plot_ratios %>%
  mutate(log_ratio = log2(ratio_dsr_asr)) %>%
  group_by(sample_type) %>%
  summarize(min = min(log_ratio),
            max = max(log_ratio))
```

```{r}
# t test to see if there is a statistically significant difference in the median dsr:asr ratio between capsule and stool samples
median_ratios <- plot_ratios %>%
  group_by(subject, sample_type) %>%
  summarize(median_ratio = median(ratio_dsr_asr))

pp = median_ratios %>% 
  # subjects 1 and 4 don't have dsr in stool
  filter(!subject %in% c(1,4)) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(sample_type, subject) %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = subject, names_from = sample_type, values_from = median_ratio)

t.test(pp$Capsule, pp$Stool, paired = TRUE)

# cohen's d
# adjust for small sample size
effectsize::cohens_d(
  pp$Capsule,
  pp$Stool,
  data=pp,
  paired = TRUE,
  adjust = TRUE,
  ci = 0.95
)

```
